Description: Yeoun portfolio demo on a dedicated USD 7 Lightsail instance. No Dealerhub resources or dependencies.

AdminCidr.Description: Operator public IPv4 only; SSH is not public.

AdminPublicKey.Description: Dedicated Yeoun public SSH key. This is not a private key.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Keep the web, API and PostgreSQL demo within the approved USD 7 instance bundle.
com.aws.cloudformation.Context.must: Dedicated Yeoun host only. Preserve disk on stack deletion. No existing service, DB, domain, VPC peering or IAM resource is changed.

UserData.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
install -d -m 700 -o ubuntu -g ubuntu /home/ubuntu/.ssh
printf '%s\n' '${AdminPublicKey}' >> /home/ubuntu/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /home/ubuntu/.ssh/authorized_keys
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2
systemctl enable --now docker
if ! swapon --show | grep -q /swapfile; then
  fallocate -l 2G /swapfile
  chmod 600 /swapfile
  mkswap /swapfile
  swapon /swapfile
  echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
fi
install -d -m 700 /etc/yeoun
install -d -m 755 /opt/yeoun
touch /opt/yeoun/bootstrap-ready

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Keep the resume QR URL stable across server restarts.
com.aws.cloudformation.Context.must: Attach only to the dedicated Yeoun server. Retained unattached IPs must be reviewed for charges.
